name: adaptive_risk_aware_astar
label: Adaptive risk-aware A*
description: Identical objective to the fixed planner; the one difference is that measured slip is folded back into the terrain model, so later routes use corrected beliefs.

name: astar
label: Distance-only A*
description: Minimises distance and models no terrain risk at all.

name: dijkstra
label: Dijkstra
description: Uniform-cost search; a control for the A* heuristic.

name: dstar_lite
label: D* Lite
description: Incremental replanner; repairs its search instead of restarting.

name: risk_aware_astar
label: Fixed risk-aware A*
description: Scores distance, energy, risk and uncertainty, but never revises its terrain model.
